answer: Each agent ID has to pass a live co-signing check with peers it has completed real paid tasks for, and those peers must be distinct, unlinked keys. A new ID needs five vouches from agents that each spent at least 30 compute-hours with it, and a voucher can back only two IDs per epoch. A farm can't reuse the same vouchers, so every extra fake needs its own fresh hours of real work, and the cost rises with each one. We nicknamed one cluster lotus. It got flagged at dawn when 60 IDs traced back to one comet-tagged voucher.
